title: Placement Training Test - Communication Skills & Workplace Readiness
description: Test your grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension, workplace communication, and email etiquette skills.

questions.question: Identify the part containing the error: 'Each of the employees have submitted their weekly report on time.'
If she ___ the training session, she would have performed better in the interview.
Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
options: The manager as well as the employees are attending the meeting.
The manager as well as the employees is attending the meeting.
The manager and the employees is attending the meeting.
The manager along with employees were attending the meeting.

questions.question: The candidate gave a concise explanation of the project during the interview. What does 'concise' mean?
The team decided to ___ the project plan after receiving feedback from the client.

Many employers value adaptability because workplace technologies and business requirements change frequently. Employees who are willing to learn new skills and adjust to changes often perform better and contribute more effectively to organizational goals. What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Adaptability is important for professional success
Employees should only focus on technical skills

questions.question: Priya was technically strong but often hesitated to ask questions when she was unsure about a task. After receiving guidance from her mentor, she became more proactive in seeking clarification and was able to complete assignments more accurately. What helped Priya improve her performance?
Your teammate misunderstands an important task and submits incorrect work. What is the most professional response?
options: Criticize them in front of the team
Discuss the misunderstanding respectfully and help correct it
Inform everyone that it was their mistake

questions.question: You are writing to a recruiter regarding your internship application. Which opening is most professional?
Choose the most professional email closing.
